title: Depth-one recursive majority
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every sign input $x$ indexed by $n^1$ coordinates, recursive majority of depth one on $x$ equals ordinary $n$-input majority applied to the signs of $x$ at the corresponding coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A sign input indexed by $n^1$ coordinates
